title: Inspect Maven-repackaged Spring Boot parent WARs by entry bytes
description: Build the exact S48 parent Maven plugin in its original integration harness. Run the Maven WAR 3.5.1 and Boot repackage goals on a small consumer. Read both SBOM manifest attributes and the bytes of the named entry with and without a differently located CycloneDX file, and record actual archive ordering. Restrict dependency resolution to prepared local caches.

steps.name: Run the original Maven integration and inspect both WAR outputs
